official_name: ERA5-Land hourly data from 1950 to present (reanalysis-era5-land)
api_or_access_channel: CDS API v2 (cdsapi Python client; https://cds.climate.copernicus.eu/api)
spatial_resolution: 0.1° x 0.1° regular lat-lon (~11.1 km x 9.6 km at 30°N; native ~9 km TCo1279)
typical_latency: Approx. 5 days (preliminary ERA5-Land-T; final validated 2-3 months later)
key_variables: 2m_temperature (K), 2m_dewpoint_temperature (K), 10m_u_component_of_wind (m/s), 10m_v_component_of_wind (m/s), total_precipitation (m), volumetric_soil_water_layer_1 (0-7 cm), layer_2 (7-28 cm), layer_3 (28-100 cm), layer_4 (100-289 cm)
missing_or_derived_variables: RH and VPD must be derived from T2m and Td2m; wind speed/direction must be derived from u10/v10; hourly precip requires de-accumulating daily 00:00 UTC reset sums
auth_and_rate_limits: Free CDS registration + API key in ~/.cdsapirc + web UI licence acceptance; queue/request limits apply
key_limitations: Accumulated fluxes reset at 00:00 UTC (easy to mis-difference); ~9-11 km grid smooths narrow Himalayan gorge microclimates; high-altitude/glacier snowpack cells require terrain awareness

official_name: ERA5 hourly data on single levels from 1940 to present (reanalysis-era5-single-levels)
api_or_access_channel: CDS API v2 (cdsapi Python client; https://cds.climate.copernicus.eu/api)
spatial_resolution: 0.25° x 0.25° regular lat-lon (~27.8 km x 24.1 km at 30°N; ~31 km at equator)
typical_latency: Approx. 5 days (ERA5T; final validated 2-3 months later)
key_variables: 2m_temperature, 2m_dewpoint_temperature, 10m_u_component_of_wind, 10m_v_component_of_wind, total_precipitation (1-hour accumulation), CAPE, boundary layer height
missing_or_derived_variables: RH/VPD derived from T2m & Td2m; wind speed/direction derived from u10/v10; coarser soil layers than ERA5-Land
auth_and_rate_limits: Free CDS registration + API key + web UI licence acceptance; queue/request limits apply
key_limitations: 0.25° resolution is 6.25x coarser in pixel area than ERA5-Land and blends foothill and mid-Himalayan elevation bands

official_name: NASA POWER Prediction Of Worldwide Energy Resources (MERRA-2 Meteorology)
provider: NASA Langley Research Center (LaRC) / NASA GMAO MERRA-2
spatial_resolution: 0.5° lat x 0.625° lon (~55.7 km x 60.3 km at 30°N; solar params at 1.0° x 1.0°)
typical_latency: Approx. 3-5 days (up to ~2 weeks for selected parameters)
key_variables: T2M, T2M_MIN, T2M_MAX (°C), RH2M (%), PRECTOTCORR (mm/day or mm/hr), WS2M, WS10M (m/s), WD2M, WD10M (deg), GWETTOP (0-5 cm), GWETROOT, GWETPROF
missing_or_derived_variables: VPD must be derived from T2M and RH2M; soil wetness is unitless (0-1) index rather than volumetric m³/m³
file_formats: JSON, CSV, NetCDF, GeoJSON, ASCII, EPW
auth_and_rate_limits: No API key required for standard access; lightweight request-size and rate limits apply
licence: NASA Open Data (public domain; NASA LaRC attribution requested)
key_limitations: Only 17 cell centers fall inside Uttarakhand (~3,360 km² per cell), severely smoothing topographic gradients across 200 m to >7,000 m relief; unsuitable as primary spatial predictor

official_name: MOD13Q1 v061 (Terra) & MYD13Q1 v061 (Aqua) Vegetation Indices 16-Day L3 Global 250m SIN Grid
api_or_access_channel: NASA AppEEARS REST API (https://appeears.earthdatacloud.nasa.gov/api) & NASA Earthdata Cloud
spatial_resolution: 250 m native Sinusoidal grid (sphere R=6,371,007.181 m); reprojected to EPSG:4326 via AppEEARS
uttarakhand_intersecting_cells: Sub-grid raster (~20 x 20 pixels per 0.05° cell)
temporal_resolution: 16-day composite per sensor (staggered Terra + Aqua yields effective 8-day cadence)
availability_2025: Full 2025 coverage available (Terra & Aqua operating prior to late-2026/2027 retirement)
key_variables: 250m 16 days NDVI (_250m_16_days_NDVI in AppEEARS/NetCDF), 250m 16 days EVI (_250m_16_days_EVI), VI Quality, pixel reliability, composite day of the year
missing_or_derived_variables: Needs QA/pixel-reliability cloud masking and causal alignment using composite end date rather than start/nominal date
auth_and_rate_limits: Free NASA Earthdata Login account required; AppEEARS asynchronous area-request queue limits apply
licence: NASA ESDS Open Data Policy (public domain / unrestricted; citation requested)
key_limitations: Monsoon/cloud contamination degrades composites; NDVI saturates over dense Himalayan pine/oak canopy (prefer EVI alongside NDVI); Terra/Aqua orbital drift alters solar geometry

official_name: VNP13A1 v002 Suomi NPP VIIRS Vegetation Indices 16-Day L3 Global 500m SIN Grid
api_or_access_channel: NASA AppEEARS REST API (https://appeears.earthdatacloud.nasa.gov/api) & NASA Earthdata Cloud
spatial_resolution: 500 m native Sinusoidal grid (R=6,371,007.181 m); reprojected via AppEEARS
uttarakhand_intersecting_cells: Sub-grid raster (~10 x 10 pixels per 0.05° cell)
availability_2025: Full 2025 coverage available on maintained sun-synchronous orbit
key_variables: 500 m 16 days NDVI, 500 m 16 days EVI, 500 m 16 days EVI2, VI Quality, composite day of the year
missing_or_derived_variables: Coarser spatial resolution (500 m vs MODIS 250 m); cross-sensor radiometric calibration differs slightly from MODIS
auth_and_rate_limits: Free NASA Earthdata Login account required; AppEEARS queue limits apply
licence: NASA ESDS Open Data Policy (public domain / unrestricted)
key_limitations: 500 m pixel area is 4x coarser than MOD13Q1 (250 m) in steep fragmented valley forests; recommended to cross-check MODIS drift and guarantee post-2026 operational continuity

official_name: MOD11A1 v061 (Terra) & MYD11A1 v061 (Aqua) Land Surface Temperature/Emissivity Daily L3 Global 1km
api_or_access_channel: NASA AppEEARS REST API (https://appeears.earthdatacloud.nasa.gov/api) & NASA Earthdata Cloud
spatial_resolution: 1 km native Sinusoidal grid (reprojected via AppEEARS)
uttarakhand_intersecting_cells: Sub-grid raster (~5 x 5 pixels per 0.05° cell)
availability_2025: Full 2025 coverage available (subject to Terra/Aqua orbital drift)
key_variables: LST_Day_1km, LST_Night_1km, QC_Day, QC_Night, Day_view_time, Night_view_time
missing_or_derived_variables: Radiometric skin temperature (not 2m air temp); heavy missingness under clouds; requires view-time QA checks
auth_and_rate_limits: Free NASA Earthdata Login account required; AppEEARS queue limits apply
licence: NASA ESDS Open Data Policy (public domain / unrestricted)
key_limitations: Strict clear-sky retrieval causes severe data voids during monsoon/winter clouds; Terra/Aqua orbital drift (ceased constellation maneuvers 2020-2021) shifts overpass local solar time, introducing spurious LST bias; potential leakage if post-fire hotspots heat pixels

official_name: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 (Global 30m Digital Surface Model / COP30)
provider: European Space Agency (ESA) / DLR & Airbus (WorldDEM / TanDEM-X)
api_or_access_channel: OpenTopography Global Datasets API (https://portal.opentopography.org/API/globaldem?demtype=COP30) & AWS Open Data S3 (copernicus-dem-30m)
spatial_resolution: 1 arc-second (~30 m horizontal; vertical datum EGM2008 orthometric)
uttarakhand_intersecting_cells: Sub-grid raster (~185 x 160 pixels per 0.05° cell)
key_variables: Elevation (m); slope (deg) and aspect (deg -> sin/cos) must be derived in metric UTM CRS (EPSG:32644)
missing_or_derived_variables: Slope, aspect, topographic wetness index, and ruggedness must be computed externally (e.g., via RichDEM/GDAL in EPSG:32644)
file_formats: Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFF (COG) on AWS; GeoTIFF via OpenTopography
auth_and_rate_limits: AWS S3 anonymous read (no key); OpenTopography requires free API key with area/daily caps
licence: Copernicus DEM Licence (free, full, and open access; requires © DLR e.V. & © Airbus Defence and Space GmbH attribution)
key_limitations: DSM reflects top-of-canopy height rather than bare-earth DTM in dense forests; vertical datum is EGM2008 (differs slightly from SRTM EGM96)

official_name: NASA SRTMGL1 v003 (Shuttle Radar Topography Mission Global 1 Arc Second Void-Filled)
api_or_access_channel: OpenTopography Global Datasets API (demtype=SRTMGL1) & NASA Earthdata Cloud / AppEEARS
historical_coverage: Static terrain product (Space Shuttle Endeavour flight Feb 11–22, 2000)
spatial_resolution: 1 arc-second (~30 m horizontal; vertical datum EGM96 orthometric)
uttarakhand_intersecting_cells: Sub-grid raster (~185 x 160 pixels per 0.05° cell)
key_variables: Elevation (m); slope and aspect must be derived in metric UTM CRS (EPSG:32644)
missing_or_derived_variables: Slope and aspect computed externally; C-band radar penetrates upper canopy partially
auth_and_rate_limits: NASA Earthdata Login or OpenTopography free API key
licence: NASA / USGS Public Domain (unrestricted use; citation requested)
key_limitations: 25+ year old Feb 2000 acquisition; C-band radar layover/foreshortening and void-fill patching using ASTER GDEM2/GMTED2010 in steep Himalayan ridges make COP30 superior for Uttarakhand

official_name: NASA GPM IMERG Version 07 Final Precipitation L3 Daily (GPM_3IMERGDF) & Half-Hourly (GPM_3IMERGHH)
provider: NASA GES DISC / JAXA GPM Mission
api_or_access_channel: NASA Earthdata Login + OPeNDAP / GES DISC Subsetter / HTTPS
spatial_resolution: 0.1° x 0.1° regular lat-lon (~11.1 km x 9.6 km at 30°N)
typical_latency: Early ~4h; Late ~14h; Final gauge-calibrated ~3.5 months after observation month
key_variables: precipitation (mm/day or mm/hr; renamed from precipitationCal in v07), MWprecipitation (formerly HQprecipitation), randomError, probabilityLiquidPrecipitation
missing_or_derived_variables: Satellite-gauge blended rainfall only; lacks temperature, wind, RH, or soil moisture
auth_and_rate_limits: Free NASA Earthdata Login required; GES DISC subsetter queue/rate limits apply
licence: CC BY 4.0 / NASA Open Data Policy
key_limitations: ~3.5-month Final latency precludes real-time use without switching to uncalibrated Early/Late runs; mountainous solid-precipitation/orographic snowfall bias requires regional caution

official_name: CHIRPS v2.0 (Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Precipitation with Station Data)
api_or_access_channel: Direct HTTPS GeoTIFF/NetCDF directory (https://data.chc.ucsb.edu/products/CHIRPS-2.0/) & Google Earth Engine / IRI
historical_coverage: 1981-01-01 to near-present (CHIRPS v2 production sunsets after Dec 2026 in favor of CHIRPS v3)
spatial_resolution: 0.05° x 0.05° quasi-global land (50°S–50°N; ~5.6 km x 4.8 km at 30°N)
uttarakhand_intersecting_cells: 2,174 intersecting (2,000 cell centers inside; exact 1:1 grid spacing match)
typical_latency: Preliminary ~2 days after pentad; Final ~3 weeks after month end
missing_or_derived_variables: Precipitation only; must be paired with meteorological reanalysis for T/RH/wind/soil moisture
auth_and_rate_limits: No authentication required on HTTPS archive
licence: CC0 1.0 Universal / Public Domain (academic citation requested)
key_limitations: Infrared cold-cloud duration (CCD) proxy + sparse high-Himalayan rain-gauge stations can under-sample warm orographic rain and alpine snow; CHIRPS v2.0 transitions to v3.0 post-2026
